title: Hello, I am Stone
excerpt: Welcome to my personal website. Learn about why I build and what I write about.
author: Stone C. Lasley
content:
Welcome to my personal site. I'm Stone C. Lasley, a software leader and builder passionate about creating elegant solutions to complex problems.

What I Do

I lead engineering teams and build software that makes a difference. My focus is on clean architecture, scalable systems, and empowering teams to do their best work.

What You'll Find Here

This site is a collection of my thoughts on software engineering, leadership, and the occasional recipe or fitness tip. I believe in continuous learning and sharing knowledge with the community.

Let's Connect

Feel free to reach out via any of the social links in the header. I'm always interested in connecting with fellow engineers and leaders.
